description_sq:
Apartamenti eshte pjese e nje residence te re e cila ndodhet ne Qerret.
Shume prane detit dhe nje zone te gjelberuar me pisha.
Mundesi pagese me keste.
Sip tot 80.6 m2
Sip perbashket 10.8 m2
Sip neto 69.8 m2
Orientim Jug
Godinat do te jene 4 kate banim + atik (loft ne katin perdhe) dhe 2 kate nentoke.
description_en: The apartment is part of a new residence located in Qerret. Very close to the sea and a green area with pine trees. Possibility of payment in installments. Total floor area 80.6 m2 Total floor area 10.8 m2 Net floor area 69.8 m2 Orientation South The buildings will have 4 residential floors + attic (loft on the ground floor) and 2 underground floors.
